description: Add framer-motion for animations and enhance UI with smooth transitions, SVG logo animations, and micro-interactions on buttons and cards
steps: Install framer-motion: run 'npm install framer-motion' from c:\examplatform\frontend

Update src/app/page.tsx landing page: wrap hero section h1 and p in motion.div with initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ duration: 0.6 }}; wrap feature cards in motion.div with whileHover={{ scale: 1.05, transition: { duration: 0.2 } }}

Update src/app/dashboard/page.tsx: wrap stat cards in motion.div with initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: index * 0.1 }}; add whileHover={{ y: -4 }} to recent attempts list items

Update src/app/papers/page.tsx: wrap paper cards in motion.div with initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}, whileHover={{ scale: 1.02, boxShadow: '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' }}
Update src/components/navbar.tsx: import motion from framer-motion, wrap nav buttons in motion.div with whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}, whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
Enhance src/app/page.tsx Brain icon: wrap in motion.div with animate={{ rotate: [0, 5, -5, 0] }}, transition={{ duration: 4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
Add global transition classes to tailwind.config.ts: in theme.extend add transitionDuration: { '400': '400ms' }, transitionTimingFunction: { 'bounce-in': 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)' }
Verify: run 'npm run build' to ensure framer-motion integrates without errors, then run 'npm run dev' and visually verify smooth animations
acceptance_criteria: framer-motion is installed and appears in package.json dependencies
Landing page hero section fades in smoothly on load
Cards across the app have hover scale animations
Brain logo has subtle rotating animation
All animations are performant and do not cause layout shifts
verification: Visual inspection: npm run dev and interact with pages to verify animations at http://localhost:3000
